units.source_text: 但得两心相通，即使凝望长空，亦可忘忧遣怀。”

en.t: If only two hearts can understand each other, then even gazing into the vast sky can make one forget sorrow and find comfort.”

units.source_text: 信中详诉衷情，不可尽记。

en.t: The letter described his true feelings in detail, more than can be fully recorded here.
